_comment: Frozen expectations for the composite score. Asserted by BOTH the Python suite (tests/unit/test_composite_score.py) and the TypeScript suite (nba-dashboard/src/lib/__tests__/compositeScore.golden.test.ts). If the two implementations drift, one of them fails against this file. Do not regenerate it to make a test pass.
formula: score_i = clamp((v - p5) / (p95 - p5)); turnovers reversed; composite = mean over all 9 * 100
boundaries_note: Pooled 2024-25 + 2025-26 game-level values. Every 5th percentile is 0 by decision.

cases.name: all_zero
cases.description: Every stat zero. Only turnovers scores, at a full 1.0, because fewer is better.

cases.name: all_at_p95
cases.description: Every counting stat exactly at its 95th percentile, zero turnovers. Perfect score.

cases.name: beyond_bounds_clamped
cases.description: Everything past its boundary. Positives clamp to 1, turnovers clamp to 0.

cases.name: exact_midpoint
cases.description: Every category at exactly half its range, turnovers included. Scores 50.

cases.name: turnovers_at_p95
cases.description: Turnovers at the 95th percentile score 0, everything else zero.

cases.name: realistic_star
cases.description: A representative star line, exercising clamping on rebounds and blocks.
